turns.content: I've been teaching myself guitar for about a year. I can play a few songs all the way through now.
A year in and playing complete songs is a solid benchmark. What style of music are you working on?
Mostly fingerpicking. I love acoustic folk and singer-songwriter stuff.
Fingerpicking is technically demanding — it takes real patience to develop. Are you working with any particular method?
A mix of YouTube tutorials and a book called The Advancing Guitarist. I find video easier for technique.
That's a good combination. The Advancing Guitarist is excellent for understanding the instrument more deeply.
I'm trying to learn Travis picking which is hurting my brain a bit but I can see how it'll unlock a lot of songs.
Travis picking is one of those techniques where it suddenly clicks and then you can't stop. Keep at it.
